purpose: A corpus-wide classification pass so no potentially relevant resource is missed by starting from a predetermined filename list. This is a breadth index, not a claim that every listed resource has been reversed -- most entries are inventory only (type/magic/count), and only the archives with a 'members' block have been enumerated and RefPack/zlib-verified.
scope_note: Repository-root and known game-subdirectory files, excluding the fnr3-re tool's own src/tests/docs/tools/config/analysis directories. 428 top-level files classified. Not yet expanded: recursive enumeration of every archive's own members (only the archives listed under 'archives_enumerated' were opened).

archives_enumerated.notes: The dominant character/model/mesh archive. body_fifadna1.msh (EA FIFA-engine-derived base body geometry), body_boxer.msh, face_hires.off/face.off/swelltool.off (facial damage/swelling geometry, cross-referencing preload/boxerpre.viv's damage morph targets and program-10 Medical), plus 62 .ord/.orl model-data pairs and 49 .o morph-target files -- far more than boxerpre.viv's original 8, confirming the .msh/.ord/.orl/.o family is used broadly across many characters, not just the shared preload base.

damage.msh/damage_0.msh/damage_1.msh/damage_2.msh (multiple damage-state body models -- direct evidence of a staged/leveled damage visualization system) plus per-glove-size/style gloves_N_M.msh models. Newly discovered this pass; not previously investigated.

shor1_<pattern><NN>.msh -- boxing shorts models by pattern name (bdstrp=bold stripe, bicolr=bicolor, etc.) and numbered variant. Directly matches preload/tables.viv's shorts.csv target. Newly discovered this pass.
face.off, face_cuts.off (direct damage/medical relevance), fringe.off, gravity_head.off, hilite.off, laces.off -- miscellaneous per-boxer appearance/damage geometry. Newly discovered this pass.

mor_hair_headgear_<code>.o -- headgear-compatibility hair morph targets keyed by a boxer short-code (agat, atar, bhop, cbyr, ...) matching the BL_<code>.viv per-boxer archives found at the repository root. Newly discovered this pass.

Two distinct kinds confirmed by direct enumeration: (1) generic hairstyle templates (afro1, aight, braid, busta, ...) each containing a full morph-target set (cranium shape x8 directions, ears x4, forebrow x2, headgear compatibility, plus a mod_hair_<style>.o base model); (2) named-legend-boxer files (hk_ali.viv, hk_hatto.viv, hk_lazca.viv, hk_leona.viv, hk_moral.viv, hk_pacqu.viv, hk_punch.viv, hk_robin.viv) each containing exactly one mod_hair_<name>.o bespoke hair model. This resolves the prior pass's CANDIDATE cross-reference to preload/bootpreloads.viv's HK_*.bh descriptors and preload/tables.viv's boxer-surname .txt files into a much better-supported PROBABLE structural family -- see boxer-ownership-map.json.

12 venue/training-location base names (atlntic, cafrica, countyf, dodge, elevese, hbtokyo, loflush, minick, sparrin, staples, trainin, viceroy), each with a paired "...t" variant. All 26 corpus .zlb files (including beload.zlb/feload.zlb) decode cleanly. Plausible but not confirmed cross-reference to xdbvenue.adf's header word0=9 (12 candidate location names is more than 9 -- at least 'sparrin'/'trainin' read as practice/training locations rather than competition venues, which would narrow the count closer to 9, but this is not proven).
